extracted.intended_audience: Project proponents, public authorities, private companies, NGOs, investors and stakeholders seeking EIB financing or information about EIB project priorities
extracted.subtask_description: Extracts the European Investment Bank's stated priorities and substantive criteria for the types of projects it finances (thematic, geographic, social and institutional priorities) to guide prospective applicants and stakeholders. Covers sectoral focus, policy objectives, geographic reach and social/strategic concerns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economic support to sectors contributing to growth, employment, regional cohesion and environmental sustainability
rubrics_metrics.description: "We provide economic support to sectors that contribute significantly to growth, employment, regional cohesion and environmental sustainability in Europe and beyond.",
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principle that financed projects should materially contribute to economic growth, job creation, regional cohesion and environmental sustainability; applies across EIB activities since 1958 and underpins sector selection and investment decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Climate and environmental sustainability (finance climate action to net zero)
rubrics_metrics.description: "We finance climate action and environmental sustainability projects around the world to place the economy on a path to net zero.",
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects aiming to reduce greenhouse gas emissions, increase resilience or otherwise advance environmental sustainability are prioritised; the Bank reports a significant share of lending supports climate action and environmental sustainability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Development finance through EIB Global (stability, sustainable growth, fight climate change)
rubrics_metrics.description: "Through EIB Global, our dedicated arm, we invest around the world to create stability, promote sustainable growth and fight climate change.",
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EIB Global channels development finance outside the EU and uses tailored instruments to promote stability, sustainable economic development and climate objectives; signals preference for projects with clear development and climate co-benefits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fragility and conflict (support for fragile and vulnerable countries)
rubrics_metrics.description: "Fragility and conflict" / "support for fragile and vulnerable countries"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EIB explicitly targets investments in fragile or conflict-affected contexts as part of social sustainability; includes specialised programmes and thematic guidance for operations in such environments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Innovation, digital and human capital (boost technological innovation and invest in people)
rubrics_metrics.description: "We help societies in their efforts to boost technological innovation and invest in their people...",
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preference for projects that build digital capacity, support deep-tech and innovation ecosystems, and invest in education/training/human capital to address demographic and structural challenges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Critical raw materials and supply-chain resilience
rubrics_metrics.description: "How critical raw materials shape Europe’s economic resilience... Why critical raw materials matter for Europe... how a secure supply supports the energy transition and the economy",
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects strengthening access to, processing of or supply chains for critical raw materials are a stated priority because they underpin competitiveness and the green transition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Security and defence (invest in industrial base, technological superiority and defence infrastructure)
rubrics_metrics.description: "The EIB Group aims to ensure Europe's peace and security through its investments in our industrial base, technological superiority and essential defence infrastructure.",
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EIB will finance projects that strengthen EU security/defence objectives, including investments in strategic industrial capacity and defence-related infrastructure; the Bank provides a one-stop-shop on security and defence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sustainable energy and natural resources (offshore wind, electricity networks, etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: "We are a key player in developing the offshore wind sector and in establishing supply chains. We also support electricity network investments for transmission and distribution.",
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Priority for renewable energy projects (e.g., offshore wind), grid/transmission investments and resource-efficient natural resource projects consistent with net-zero goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agriculture and bioeconomy (sustainable agriculture investments)
rubrics_metrics.description: List item: "Agriculture" and associated mention of biocontrols example (GreenLight Biosciences)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports projects that improve agricultural sustainability (e.g., reducing chemical use, adopting biocontrols, improving resilience) and that align with climate/environmental objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Circular economy (recycling, resource efficiency)
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed thematic focus: "Circular economy" (e.g., recycling)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preference for investments that close material loops, reduce waste and foster recycling and circular business models as part of environmental sustainability objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Energy (renewables, energy efficiency and energy transition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed thematic focus: "Energy" and multiple articles on clean energy transition
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports renewable generation, energy efficiency measures, and projects that reduce fossil fuel import dependence and increase energy security.

rubrics_metrics.name: Forestry (sustainable forestry projects)
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed thematic focus: "Forestry"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Financing for forestry projects that contribute to environmental sustainability, carbon sequestration, and sustainable land management.

rubrics_metrics.name: Solid waste management
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed thematic focus: "Solid waste"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects improving urban and regional waste management systems, reducing landfill and increasing recycling are within the Bank's remit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sustainable oceans (marine environment investments)
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed thematic focus: "Sustainable oceans"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects supporting marine conservation, sustainable fisheries, and blue economy initiatives that align with environmental sustainability goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Water and wastewater infrastructure
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed thematic focus: "Water and wastewater" and example "safer drinking water in Lesotho",
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Financing of water supply, sanitation and wastewater treatment infrastructure to improve public health and environmental outcomes; emphasis on impact evaluation and baselines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sustainable cities and regions (urban development and green transport)
rubrics_metrics.description: "We support projects that make life in urban areas more sustainable. We also promote safe, affordable, green and efficient urban transport around the world.",
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritises urban development projects that enhance sustainability, mobility, housing affordability and urban public services; includes support for transport, social and affordable housing and trans-European networks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transport infrastructure (urban and trans‑European networks)
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed focus: "Transport" / "Trans-European Networks"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finances transport projects that improve connectivity, efficiency and sustainability of passenger and freight networks at urban, regional and EU-wide scales.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social and affordable housing
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed focus: "Social and affordable housing"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports housing projects that increase affordability and social inclusion as part of cohesion and social sustainability objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for SMEs and mid-caps (intermediated products with EIF)
rubrics_metrics.description: "Smaller companies are a driving force for economic development. Together with the European Investment Fund, we support businesses with a wide range of intermediated products.",
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preference for financing instruments that improve access to capital for SMEs and mid-cap firms, using intermediated finance and EIF-managed risk finance to stimulate private investment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Risk finance through the European Investment Fund (EIF)
rubrics_metrics.description: "Risk finance through the European Investment Fund"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EIF-provided risk finance and guarantees are core instruments for mobilising private investment; projects using these instruments to leverage additional finance are within scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cohesion (address inequalities; promote jobs, education, infrastructure, healthy environment)
rubrics_metrics.description: "The EU cohesion policy aims to bring about prosperity among all EU Member States. Our projects seek to address inequalities in all regions by providing job and education opportunities, access to public infrastructure and services, and a healthy and sustainable environment.",
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects should demonstrably contribute to reducing regional disparities, creating employment and educational opportunities, and delivering inclusive public infrastructure and environmental benefits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social sustainability (equality, human dignity and support for fragile/vulnerable countries)
rubrics_metrics.description: "Social sustainability is fundamental in everything we do. Equality, human dignity and support for fragile and vulnerable countries are central to our mission.",
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EIB requires that projects respect and promote gender equality, human rights and social inclusion; social sustainability is a cross-cutting criterion in project selection and implementation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic reach and eligibility (operate in EU and globally)
rubrics_metrics.description: "We operate both in the EU and around the world. Our global financial operations help create growth and opportunity on all continents.",
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EIB finances projects within the EU, in enlargement/neighbourhood countries and in global regions through EIB Global; geographic remit informs the type of instruments and priorities applied.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for Ukraine (urgent needs and reconstruction)
rubrics_metrics.description: "Following Russia's unjustified attack to Ukraine, we remain committed to supporting the country for its most urgent needs and its effort to reconstruct.",
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Targeted financing and trust-fund instruments (e.g., EU for Ukraine trust fund) to address emergency needs, reconstruction and resilience in Ukraine are explicit priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project scale and alignment with EU policy objectives (large and small projects supporting EU policy)
rubrics_metrics.description: "We help finance large and small-scale investment projects that support EU policy objectives.",
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Both macro-scale infrastructure and smaller targeted investments are eligible provided they align with EU policy aims (climate, cohesion, competitiveness, security, etc.) and demonstrate expected impact.
